name: Vehicle GPS trackers & fleet telematics
source: Identifiers checked 2026-10-31 against the bundled IEEE OUI and Bluetooth SIG registries (company IDs, member UUIDs); names are vendor/model strings. Most trackers report over cellular and only advertise BLE/Wi-Fi for configuration, pairing or short-range features — absence of a hit is not proof there is no tracker.

rules.label: Fleet telematics unit
rules.note: Telematics/GPS tracking units common in Australian commercial fleets (EROAD, Teletrac Navman, Cartrack, Smartrak, Geotab, Samsara).

rules.label: GPS tracker / telematics unit
rules.note: Vehicle/asset GPS trackers: Teltonika (company 0x089A; OUIs 38:8A:21, 6C:AF:AB, 7C:D9:F4, 00:1E:42), Geotab (0x0275), Samsara (0x0B6B, UUIDs 0xFC86/FC87/FCE4/FCE5/FE9B), Ruptela (0x0E5F), Queclink (0x0E61, 78:05:41), Jimi IoT / Concox (0x0FC3, B4:A8:28), CalAmp, LoJack, Suntech, Pointer, Zonar, Verizon Connect, Navman, Invoxia (consumer), Katch (AU). A tracker that keeps appearing near you or your car is worth checking.
